blocks.content: Here's the approach: App.jsx owns the theme state and passes it down to every component that needs it.
This works, but it already feels heavy.
And we haven't even started passing theme deeper, from HomePage down to Header, or from EntryDetailPage down to whatever components live inside it.
This pattern has a name. Let's look at why it becomes a problem.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
